# Source Han Sans

Adobe Source Han Sans **2.005R**, regional subset variable WOFF2 (OpenType/CFF2).
Original files are stored unchanged and served locally; no CDN requests are needed.
Supported weight range: 250–900. Korean is the default; Japanese (`ja` and the
existing `jp_JA` locale) selects the Japanese family first via `css/fonts.css`.
Both families are available as fallbacks for mixed-language text.

- Release: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-sans/releases/tag/2.005R
- Korean: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-sans/2.005R/Variable/WOFF2/OTF/Subset/SourceHanSansKR-VF.otf.woff2
- Japanese: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-sans/2.005R/Variable/WOFF2/OTF/Subset/SourceHanSansJP-VF.otf.woff2
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-sans/2.005R/LICENSE.txt
